09.6.new: - THE ENGINE HOLDS THE ONE SHARED LIBRARY; THE CHILD READS IT FROM THE CALL AND CHECKS IT AT ITS LOAD (ASK 422(a), ASK 578; engine "Library Sha (ASK 422a)" and "Alternate Pass Call"; child workflow MqQHRl7mQQ0z8QdT, "Library Check (ASK 422a)" and its 14 library readers):

09.6.old: each hold their own Shared Library node. A library change was built, graded, carded and read back twice, and nothing stopped a run whose two copies differed.
09.6.new: each held their own Shared Library node. A library change was built, graded, carded and read back twice, and nothing stopped a run whose two copies differed. The child's copy is removed: the child has no Shared Library node, and the engine sends its library text in the call. Where an entry of this manual says "Shared Library, both copies", "both libraries", or "the engine and the child" of a library line, a MAP entry or the library header, it now means the engine's Shared Library, which the child reads; where any other entry differs from this one on the child's library, this entry is right. A library change is made on the engine only.

09.6.old: keys sorted, each entry from that workflow's own MAP. The child takes all its keys. The engine takes its keys less the named list MAPEXTRA, today ["REFP"] (ASK 409), and gives no map_sha unless every listed key is present. So map_sha differs when a shared entry changes, a child key is missing from the engine, an unlisted key is engine-only, or REFP is missing from the engine.
09.6.new: keys sorted, less the keys of the named list MAPEXTRA, today ["REFP", "Alternate Merge CPD"]; no map_sha is given unless every listed key is present. The engine computes both values from its own Shared Library. The child computes both from the text it receives, by the same rule and the same list, which its Library Check node holds.

09.6.old: "Alternate Pass Call" sends lib_sha and map_sha in pass, not in sa. In the child, "Library Check (ASK 422a)", between "Alternate Pass In" and "Alternate Pass Check", computes both from the child's own library and stops the child with "pkgLIB1: library drift, engine lib <x> map <y>, child lib <x> map <y>" unless both pairs are equal; when they are, it passes on lib422, which names all four values.
09.6.new: "Alternate Pass Call" sends the library text (lib, read from the Shared Library node when the call is made), lib_sha and map_sha in pass, not in sa. In the child, "Library Check (ASK 422a)", between "Alternate Pass In" and "Alternate Pass Check", stops the child with "pkgLIB1: the call carries no library text (ASK 578)" when lib is absent or empty. Else it computes both values from the received text and stops the child with "pkgLIB1: the library text received differs from the engine library, engine lib <x> map <y>, received lib <x> map <y>" unless both pairs are equal; when they are, it removes lib from pass and passes on lib422, which names all four values. The child's 14 library readers (R2 Alternate Build, R2 Alternate Merge Seat, R2 Alt Judge Enforcer Build, R2 Alt Judge Enforcer Record, R2 Alt Send Back Build, R2 Alt Send Back Record, R2 Alt Gate Build, R2 Alt Gate Record, R2 Alt Late Gate Build, R2 Alt Judge Enforcer Retry Build, R2 Alternate Payloads, R2 Alternate Cure Build, R2 Alternate Cure Normalize and R2 Alternate Merge) read the text from the output of "Alternate Pass In" (pass.lib).
